name: task-interactions
description:
Cross-blueprint contract layer for the inline-dataview-field task grammar (`- [ ] x [project:: [[Y]]] [priority:: high] [due:: Z]`). Exposes `customJS.TaskInteractions` with one parser, one serializer (delegates to ToDoCreateTask.serializePayloadToLine for byte-identical output), pure sentinel-marker injectors (`<!-- ACTION_ITEMS_MARKER -->`, `<!-- TODAY_CAPTURE_MARKER -->`), a fence-aware task-line scanner, plus type-dispatched `appendTask` / `replaceTaskAt` writers that never throw. Introduced at sauce v0.127.0 as the foundation for the meeting New-Task dual-write (§C) and to-do click-to-edit (§F) consumers; positioned for project blueprint consumption (rich ProjectMeetingsPanel rows) in a later cycle.

v0.2.0 (sauce v0.128.0) — adds the third anchor-sentinel family member `ownedTasksAnchor()` returning `<!-- OWNED_TASKS_MARKER -->`, plus `injectOwnedTasksMarker(body)` (idempotent pure body transform; regex-based SectionLabel matcher accepting both `text: "Owned Tasks"` and `text: "Owned Tasks", top: true` forms). `findTaskLines` extended to accept `"ownedTasks"` as a third valid `sectionAnchor` value alongside `"todayCapture"` and `"actionItems"` (reuses the existing fence-aware scope-bounded scanner). `appendTask` `type === "project-todo"` branch loosened (literal-string needle replaced with the same regex) and refactored to a marker-preferred insertion path that mirrors the existing meeting + to-do branches — fixes a silent v0.127.0 fall-through where project-todo notes whose Owned Tasks SectionLabel carried `top: true` didn't match the literal needle and instead appended to end-of-file. Powers the Project To-Do click-to-edit consumer surface for v0.128.0.
